name: Happy birthday
description: Arrives a few days before the client's birthday. Never mentions age or year.
guidelines: Wish them a happy birthday from the whole salon. Keep it light and joyful. Do not mention age, birth year or the exact date. If there is an offer, present it as a small birthday treat from the team, once, with the code, and nothing pushy.
